tools.name: consumer-credit_reg-z-apr
tools.description: Compute the US closed-end credit APR with the Reg Z Appendix J actuarial method and optional disclosure tolerance check. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/consumer-credit/reg-z-apr. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: consumer-credit_uk-early-settlement
tools.description: Compute the statutory minimum early-settlement rebate and settlement figure under the Consumer Credit (Early Settlement) Regulations 2004. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/consumer-credit/uk-early-settlement. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: consumer-credit_apy-calculate
tools.description: Compute annual percentage yield for US deposit disclosures under Reg DD Appendix A, including stepped and tiered rates. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/consumer-credit/apy-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: consumer-credit_pmi-termination-dates
tools.description: Compute Homeowners Protection Act cancellation, automatic termination and final termination dates from the amortization schedule. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/consumer-credit/pmi-termination-dates. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: consumer-credit_reg-f-call-frequency
tools.description: Check a debt-collector call log against the Reg F 7-in-7 presumption per debt. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/consumer-credit/reg-f-call-frequency. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "consumer-credit" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: consumer-credit_reg-z-apr, consumer-credit_reg-f-call-frequency · Public sink: consumer-credit_reg-z-apr, consumer-credit_uk-early-settlement, consumer-credit_apy-calculate, consumer-credit_pmi-termination-dates, consumer-credit_reg-f-call-frequency · Destructive: consumer-credit_reg-z-apr, consumer-credit_uk-early-settlement, consumer-credit_apy-calculate, consumer-credit_pmi-termination-dates, consumer-credit_reg-f-call-frequency.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: consumer-credit_reg-z-apr, consumer-credit_reg-f-call-frequency · Public sink: consumer-credit_reg-z-apr, consumer-credit_uk-early-settlement, consumer-credit_apy-calculate, consumer-credit_pmi-termination-dates, consumer-credit_reg-f-call-frequency · Destructive: consumer-credit_reg-z-apr, consumer-credit_uk-early-settlement, consumer-credit_apy-calculate, consumer-credit_pmi-termination-dates, consumer-credit_reg-f-call-frequency

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
